entities.summary: Jasurbek Latipov is an Uzbekistani boxer, born in Andijan. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, he competed in the Men's flyweight, but was defeated in the third round. In the 2013 World Amateur Championships, he reached the final, where he lost to Mikhail Aloyan. In 2016, Latipov won the bronze medal at the international championship in Bishkek. In 2017, he reached the final again, this time losing the Cuban boxer, Yosbany Veitia. That year, he also won the Asian Championships, beating In Kyu Kim in the final. In 2018, he won the Flyweight division at the Asian Games, beating Rogen Ladon.
